subject: SDK Gateway: runtime contract & SLI acceptance for ISV integrations
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@langsmith.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: SDK Gateway for telemetry + prompt tracing

Hi Stephanie,

Great to meet at LLMCon last month — thanks again for the demo. LangSmith Labs has been piloting a lightweight runtime 'SDK Gateway' that standardizes telemetry, prompt-level traceability, and a small contract for SLI reporting across ISV SDKs (LangChain, LlamaIndex, and a few prompt toolkits). We think it maps cleanly to Redwood's telemetry and rollout model and would like to propose a short pilot to validate interoperability and acceptance criteria.

High-level ask:
- Run a 2-week pilot connecting LangSmith's gateway to a Redwood staging runtime.
- Agree on an SLI matrix (error rate, tail latency, KV-cache hit rate, trace completeness).
- Define acceptance tests and a minimal runtime contract (pact) for SDK behavior during failover.

I've attached an outline (langsmith-sdk-gateway-outline.pdf) and a rough draft of the pact (draft-pact.json).

Would you be the right person to coordinate this? If not, please point me to the best contact.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Integrations, LangSmith Labs
Elena@langsmith.ai

Attachments: langsmith-sdk-gateway-outline.pdf, draft-pact.json
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@langsmith.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: SDK Gateway for telemetry + prompt tracing

Elena — thanks, this looks promising. I'm happy to coordinate.

Quick alignment items before we schedule the pilot:
- We need a concrete SLI matrix (error %, p99/p95 latency for token streaming, KV cache hit ratio, and percent of requests with full prompt trace). Can you propose target thresholds for a successful run?
- Security/compliance: will the gateway forward any PII back to LangSmith's servers? If so, we need a data-flow diagram.
- Rolling failure modes: Redwood needs a clear contract for SDK fallbacks (e.g., if gateway is unreachable, SDK must support local fallback and not block production flows).

Looping in Karthik and Marissa for runtime and partner ops intake. Karthik — can your team review the draft pact and suggest any required guardrails? Marissa — ops/CS may want to own the pilot running checklist.

I'll block a 30m sync this week once we have proposed SLI targets.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of ISV Partnerships, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@langsmith.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: SDK Gateway for telemetry + prompt tracing

Quick technical readout from runtime perspective:

Reviewed draft-pact.json — overall approach is reasonable but we need clearer hooks for:
- KV cache coherency: define keys that are allowed to be cached/evicted and signals for invalidation.
- Trace correlation IDs: SDK must propagate Redwood request_id for cross-system traces.
- Backpressure behavior: gateway timeouts must be enforced client-side to avoid token-stream stalls.

I've attached a suggested SLI matrix (runtime-sli-matrix.xlsx) with tentative thresholds we typically accept for pilots:
- 99th-token latency (streaming): < 600ms
- Error rate (5xx): < 0.5% over 24h window
- Trace completeness: > 98% of requests include full prompt+response checkpoint markers
- KV cache hit ratio: > 65% for repeat prefix workloads planned in pilot

On the pact itself, I added a small 'graceful-degradation' section to require SDKs to continue local generation with a specified fallback model if gateway RPCs fail for > 200ms. That prevents global outages during unstable vendor connectivity.

If this looks good we can draft a short SOW for partner sign-off. I recommend Redwood provide a staging tenant and test harness; LangSmith runs their gateway and we collect telemetry for 2 weeks.

-Karthik
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime
karthik@redwood.com

Attachments: runtime-sli-matrix.xlsx
From: Tom Brooks <tom@llamaworks.io>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena@langsmith.ai>
Cc: BridgeOps Partnerships <partners@bridgeops.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: SDK Gateway for telemetry + prompt tracing

Thanks for including LlamaWorks (we've been exploring similar gateways for LlamaIndex). A couple quick redlines from our side on the pact:
- Require opt-in telemetry for any payloads that include user-generated content; default must be no forwarding.
- Add a 30-day data retention cap for any cached prompts stored at the gateway.
- Clarify failure semantics for streaming: if gateway returns partial tokens, SDK should surface partial outputs to the app and log an event for trace continuity.

Attaching a redline doc with suggested language (redlines_v1.docx). We're supportive of a 2-week pilot but would like the SOW to include a rollback clause and a simple commercial term (no charge for pilot).

Tom Brooks
Head of Integrations, LlamaWorks / BridgeOps
tom@llamaworks.io

Attachments: redlines_v1.docx
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@langsmith.ai>, Tom Brooks <tom@llamaworks.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: SDK Gateway for telemetry + prompt tracing

All — great feedback, thanks. Next steps:
1) Elena / LangSmith: please confirm you accept the suggested SLI thresholds from Karthik or propose alternate numeric values in the shared sheet.
2) Partners (LangSmith / LlamaWorks): confirm telemetry opt-in and retention limits; we'll require a short data-flow doc before the pilot kicks off.
3) Redwood: Marissa and Vivek will draft a one-page SOW (no charge pilot, rollback clause) and provide a staging tenant. SOW target: 1 business day to circulate first draft.
4) Schedule 30m sync: I propose Thu May 6 at 10am PT — does that work?

Marissa / Vivek, please attach the draft SOW and the staging access instructions when available (redwood-sdk-gateway-sow.pdf).

If everyone agrees, we can start tests next Monday and collect metrics for two full business weeks.

—Stephanie
Head of ISV Partnerships, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-sdk-gateway-sow.pdf
